definition: A person who organizes and operates a business or businesses, taking on greater than normal financial risks in order to do so.
A system or organization in which people or groups are ranked one above the other according to status or authority.
A unit of pronunciation having one vowel sound, with or without surrounding consonants, forming the whole or a part of a word.
Causing or showing a fondness for causing trouble in a playful way.
A person or thing that is a perfect example of a particular quality or type.
A person with whom one works in a profession or business.
Provide lodging or sufficient space for; fit in with the wishes or needs of.
The way in which a word is pronounced.
The power to fascinate someone; the quality of being fascinating.
Occurring, operating, or done at the same time.
